I am 27 years old with a small farm of 0.65 hectares, so I must be careful with every kwacha. My beans plot is only 0.08 hectares, and beans fix nitrogen in the soil, so I see no reason to waste expensive chemical fertilizer here when I need it for maize. I will plant seed I saved from last season's harvest and do all the weeding by hand with my family, because I cannot afford pesticides, herbicides, or hired labor. We will rely entirely on the rains since I have no pump or irrigation scheme, and my wife and I can manage the plot ourselves during the season.
